fullPassage: What consequences of eating too many grapes and other sweet fruit could there possibly be for our brains? A few large studies have helped to shed some light. In one, higher fruit intake in older, cognitively healthy adults was linked with less volume in the hippocampus. This finding was unusual, since people who eat more fruit usually display the benefits associated with a healthy diet. In this study, however, the researchers isolated various components of the subjects' diets and found that fruit didn't seem to be doing their memory centers any favors. Another study from the Mayo Clinic saw a similar inverse relationship between fruit intake and volume of the cortex, the large outer layer of the brain. Researchers in the latter study noted that excessive consumption of high-sugar fruit (such as mangoes, bananas, and pineapples) may cause metabolic and cognitive problems as much as processed carbs do.

det.analysis: __________ carbs → 명사(carbs)를 수식하는 형용사 자리. process(동사) → processed(과거분사/형용사)로 변환.
det.tip: process(가공하다) → processed(가공된). processed carbs = 가공 탄수화물

questions.passage: What consequences of eating too many grapes and other sweet fruit could there possibly be for our brains? A few large studies have helped to __________. In one, higher fruit intake in older, cognitively healthy adults was linked with less volume in the hippocampus. This finding was unusual, since people who eat more fruit usually display the benefits associated with a healthy diet. In this study, however, the researchers isolated various components of the subjects' diets and found that fruit didn't seem to be doing their memory centers any favors. Another study from the Mayo Clinic saw a similar inverse relationship between fruit intake and volume of the cortex, the large outer layer of the brain. Researchers in the latter study noted that excessive consumption of high-sugar fruit (such as mangoes, bananas, and pineapples) may cause metabolic and cognitive problems as much as processed carbs do.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 몇몇 대규모 연구가 '약간의 빛을 비추는 데(밝히는 데)' 도움을 주었다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① eat more fruit — 과일을 더 먹다 (helped to ___와 문맥상 어색)
❌ ② cause metabolic and cognitive problems — 대사·인지 문제를 일으키다 (연구가 문제를 일으킨 것이 아님)
✅ ③ shed some light — 밝히다, 해명하다 ←정답
❌ ④ display the benefits — 이점을 보여주다 (연구가 이점을 보여준 것이 아님)
det.tip: shed some light = 빛을 비추다, 해명하다

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 과일이 그들의 기억 중추에 '도움이 되지 않는 것 같다'는 연구 결과.
det.analysis:
❌ ① linked with less volume — 적은 용적과 연관되다 (didn't seem to be ___와 구문 부적합)
✅ ② doing their memory centers any favors — 기억 중추에 도움이 되다. didn't seem to be ___와 결합하여 부정문 ←정답
❌ ③ associated with a healthy diet — 건강한 식단과 관련되다 (주어가 fruit이므로 문맥 부적합)
❌ ④ causing metabolic problems — 대사적 문제를 일으키다 (didn't seem to be ___와 구문 부적합)
det.tip: do someone a favor = ~에게 도움이 되다. do ~ any favors = ~에게 어떤 도움도 되다

ch: doing their memory centers any favors
